provenance.construction: Prime generalized-bicycle code on Z_337: H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] with a = [2,21,37,50,66,76,80,82,84,105,118,208,230,246,314] and b = [25,26,90,108,174,179,183,200,230,250,266,279,283,310,334], both weight 15, so the check weight is 30. 337 is prime with ord_337(2) = 21, so x^337-1 splits as (x+1) times sixteen irreducibles of degree 21 and every divisor has degree 21j or 21j+1; k = 2 deg gcd(a, b, x^337-1) = 2*84 = 168 by construction, before any rank is computed.
provenance.notes: Distance is a witness-backed upper bound. Ladder at 200k/2M/8M/20M/50M/150M RIS trials: 84, 80, 78, 74, 74, 74, three consecutive rungs at 74 across a factor of seven in budget. The search that produced the candidate reported 78 at 20M, four heavy; an independent 20M pass at another seed returned 76, so single deep readings vary at this blocklength and the ladder is the evidence rather than its last rung. The committed X witness is the weight-74 operator from the seed-23 50M pass, re-validated by rank; the Z witness is its image under the generalized-bicycle block-swap-and-negate symmetry, validated the same way.
